description: This is the pilot building dataset of the URBAN PERiSCOPE project (Portal for heritage buildings integration into the contemporary built environment), documenting building LIM_411 in Limassol, Cyprus. It was deposited on Zenodo on 6 December 2022 by Georgios Artopoulos and Marissia Deligiorgi of The Cyprus Institute. The building, at Agkiras 147 in the old Turkish Cypriot quarter, was a girls' school and later a police station and is now a bi-communal multi-functional centre; it is a single-storey stone building with timber roof. The archive holds a heritage BIM model (Revit with 28 families, IFC and FBX), a LAS existing-conditions point cloud with ReCap files, identity data spreadsheets, a building description, drawings and 334 photographs. Coverage: one heritage building; a companion CC BY 4.0 dataset from the Cyprus University of Technology gives Landsat land surface temperature, NDVI and NDBI for Limassol and Strovolos from 2013 to 2020. Access: Zenodo. Licence: not stated on the pilot record; free. Caveats: one building only, and no licence is given. Simulation uses: heritage digital twins, retrofit and life-cycle assessment of historic buildings, and urban heat context. Related records: HES designations and the listed building records.
